content: To access the main page, click here. Introduction to the Page The title of the page should be formatted as follows: (Disease name) case study one, with only the first letter of the title capitalized. The primary objective of this page is to provide detailed case reports of the disease observed in the hospital setting. At the top of the edit box, include the following elements: the {{CMG}} template, your name template, and the microchapter navigation template that you created earlier. This is consistent with the format used for all microchapter pages linking to the main page. When creating links within WikiDoc, ensure that key terms are enclosed in brackets to link them to other relevant pages. The links should be as specific as possible. For instance, if a sentence includes the term anterior spinal artery syndrome, the link should direct to the page for anterior spinal artery syndrome rather than generic terms like anterior, artery, or syndrome. For additional guidance on creating links, click here. Follow the formatting and capitalization guidelines as outlined in the provided template. Patient Presentation This section should provide a detailed description of the case as it was presented during morning reports. Include the symptoms the patient exhibited at the time of presentation, as well as the history of the present illness. Document any medications and supplements the patient is currently taking. A review of systems may also be included in this section. Patient History This section should detail the patient’s past medical history, including previous hospitalizations and surgeries. Include any relevant family history of illnesses. Physical Exam Document the patient’s vital signs in this section. Include pertinent positive and negative findings observed during the physical examination. Diagnostic Approach This section should describe the diagnostic approach, including laboratory studies, imaging, and other diagnostic tests. Explain how the diagnostic process helps to rule out various conditions listed in the differential diagnosis. Laboratory and Imaging Findings Include relevant laboratory findings in this section. Document imaging findings and the results of other diagnostic studies. Diagnosis and Management Provide a detailed description of the diagnosis and explain how it was established. Outline the treatment plan, including any prophylactic measures implemented to prevent complications associated with the condition.
